answer: Randomized admission lottery. Each period a verifiable random beacon draws a limited set of new agent slots from all applicants, seeded after applications close, so identities cannot be timed or targeted. Unselected applicants must reapply and pay fresh registration work each round, and duplicated identities split their own admission odds. A trellis of prior participation records then gates slot renewal; a lotus of audited activity history must persist. Attackers face a reef of repeated rejected applications, multiplying compute and fee costs per sybil while admission stays unpredictable.
